contract: Resume the restored campaign only when the unchanged controller accepts the same JSON-valued plan, benchmark, source, manifests and completed stages. Convert only the controller module's dataclass metadata representation; preserve real dataclass objects and every original rejection guard.
faults_to_detect: Original saved JSON arrays are rejected against in-memory tuples
Adapter bypasses budget, model, source or frozen-controller identity checks
Adapter changes real model configurations, training serialization or stdlib bindings
Adapter admits benchmark mode, a new run, an implicit benchmark or nonfinite metadata
layer: Small experiment-local CPU integration checks against the actual restored plan and original controller.train; stop before training with a BaseException sentinel so the controller cannot catch it and write failure state.
new_checks_reason: Existing tests cover another campaign controller and the training runner, but do not exercise this frozen controller's restored JSON plan comparison. No unrelated training suite or GPU preflight is repeated.

budget.shared_setup: Import the real frozen modules once; no model construction, forward, GPU initialization, dataset preparation or remote writes. The acceptance path reads existing CPU checkpoints to retain completed-stage guards.
budget.measurement: unittest result records each method duration, subtest results and shared setup duration; any over-target time is reported with its asset-read/import reason. Relevant ruff and bytecode compilation checks are recorded separately.
